verdict.rationale: The documented transaction-process endpoint creates a transaction and runs payment screening, and PAYMENT_SCREENING_CASES appear as an export type, so payment screening with resulting cases is a first-party capability. Inspecting decisions and matches is documented in general terms (case decisions, case audit trail, API or web review of alerts and risks), but mostly for customer screening rather than specifically for payments. missing for 10: explicit pre-release hold/release semantics, documentation of the payment screening decision output and its supporting sanctions matches, payment-specific case review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
